policies.using:
((account_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.account_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator.creator_profile cp
  WHERE ((cp.id = team_invitation.creator_id) AND (cp.account_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.account_id'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid)))))

policies.name: audit_read
policies.using:
((actor_account_id = creator_trust.current_account()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator_trust.safety_case c
  WHERE ((c.id = access_audit.case_id) AND ((c.reporter_account_id = creator_trust.current_account()) OR (c.subject_account_id = creator_trust.current_account()))))))

policies.name: access_self
policies.check:
((account_id = creator_trust.current_account()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator_trust.safety_case c
  WHERE ((c.id = case_access.case_id) AND creator_trust.may_queue(c.queue)))))

policies.name: event_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator_trust.safety_case c
  WHERE ((c.id = case_event.case_id) AND ((c.reporter_account_id = creator_trust.current_account()) OR (c.subject_account_id = creator_trust.current_account()) OR creator_trust.has_case_access(c.id)))))

policies.name: evidence_insert
policies.check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator_trust.safety_case c
  WHERE ((c.id = case_evidence.case_id) AND (c.reporter_account_id = creator_trust.current_account()))))

policies.name: effect_recovery
policies.using:
((state = ANY (ARRAY['blocked'::text, 'retry'::text, 'dead_letter'::text])) AND creator_trust.has_case_access(case_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator_trust.ops_member m
  WHERE ((m.account_id = creator_trust.current_account()) AND m.supervisor AND (m.revoked_at IS NULL) AND (m.expires_at > now())))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator_trust.safety_case c
  WHERE ((c.id = effect.case_id) AND (c.state = 'action_pending'::text) AND (c.version = effect.decision_version)))))
policies.check:
((state = 'pending'::text) AND (lease_until IS NULL) AND (lease_token IS NULL) AND (error_code IS NULL) AND creator_trust.has_case_access(case_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator_trust.ops_member m
  WHERE ((m.account_id = creator_trust.current_account()) AND m.supervisor AND (m.revoked_at IS NULL) AND (m.expires_at > now())))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator_trust.safety_case c
  WHERE ((c.id = effect.case_id) AND (c.state = 'action_pending'::text) AND (c.version = effect.decision_version)))))

policies.name: notice_insert
policies.check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM creator_trust.safety_case c
  WHERE ((c.id = notice.case_id) AND creator_trust.has_case_access(c.id) AND ((notice.recipient_account_id = c.reporter_account_id) OR (notice.recipient_account_id = c.subject_account_id)))))

functions.name: canonical_json
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION creator.canonical_json(value jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE jsonb_typeof(value)
    WHEN 'object' THEN '{' || coalesce((SELECT string_agg(to_jsonb(key)::text || ':' || creator.canonical_json(val), ',' ORDER BY key COLLATE "C") FROM jsonb_each(value) AS pairs(key,val)), '') || '}'
    WHEN 'array' THEN '[' || coalesce((SELECT string_agg(creator.canonical_json(val), ',' ORDER BY ordinal) FROM jsonb_array_elements(value) WITH ORDINALITY AS items(val,ordinal)), '') || ']'
    ELSE value::text END;
$function$

functions.name: commerce_scope
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION creator.commerce_scope(c uuid, f uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT (f IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM creator.fan_profile p WHERE p.id=f AND p.account_id=nullif(current_setting('app.account_id',true),'')::uuid))
 OR (c IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM creator.creator_profile p WHERE p.id=c AND p.account_id=nullif(current_setting('app.account_id',true),'')::uuid AND p.verification='verified'));
$function$

functions.name: has_case_access
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION creator_trust.has_case_access(c uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM creator_trust.case_access a JOIN creator_trust.ops_member m ON m.account_id=a.account_id
 WHERE a.case_id=c AND a.account_id=creator_trust.current_account() AND a.expires_at>now() AND m.revoked_at IS NULL AND m.expires_at>now())
$function$

functions.name: may_queue
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION creator_trust.may_queue(q text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM creator_trust.ops_member WHERE account_id=creator_trust.current_account() AND q=ANY(queues) AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at>now())
$function$
